title: Implement New Diagram action and canvas initialization
description: Create the 'New Diagram' action/button that initializes an empty diagram canvas. When clicked, the canvas should be cleared and ready for adding tables and relationships.
acceptanceCriteria: New Diagram button/action is available in the UI
Clicking New Diagram displays an empty canvas
Canvas is ready for tables and relationships to be added

evidence: commit:45731ad (TASK-002: fix TypeScript errors blocking build for canvas verification) pushed to origin/ticket/TASK-002
files changed: src/__tests__/ConnectionForm.test.ts (unused 'form' parameter prefixed with _), src/__tests__/DiagramCanvas.test.ts (removed unused makeTable helper)
